records.rationale: The diff shows embed#best is public (no authentication), calls params.require(:embed_url) with no length cap, and for unknown URLs unconditionally calls Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...) with the raw embed_url in job args before any dedup/throttle — the 60s setnx throttle lives inside TopicRetriever.retrieved_recently?, i.e., after the job is already enqueued and args stored in redis. The referer check (URI(request.referer).host == embeddable_host) is client-supplied and trivially forged.
